description: This bar chart, titled "Before Generation, Align it! A Novel and Effective Strategy for Mitigating Hallucinations in Text-to-SQL Generation," compares the execution accuracy of two SQL generation methods, NatSQL and TA-SQL, across four categories: Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total. The vertical axis, labeled "Execution Accuracy," is scaled linearly from 20 to 60, with tick marks at intervals of 10. The horizontal axis lists the four categories in order from left to right. For each category, there are two adjacent bars: a light blue bar representing NatSQL and a darker blue bar representing TA-SQL, as indicated by the legend. The specific values are labeled on top of each bar: for the "Simple" category, NatSQL has an accuracy of 60.21 and TA-SQL has 63.14; for "Moderate," NatSQL is 39.64 and TA-SQL is 48.60; for "Challenging," NatSQL is 32.32 and TA-SQL is 36.11; and for "Total," NatSQL is 51.35 and TA-SQL is 56.19. The bars are not sorted and are presented in the order of the categories listed on the x-axis. All bars are solid-colored with no additional visual emphasis such as shading or outlines.
